name: Lights over the station
notes: Played by FS47Attention (S47Attention.cpp, N1110) a warning. The code puts a slow formation over SARO when the player is there.

beats.text: They're over the station now. Same as the ones I was watching.
Something is humming over the roof.
At {clock} lights went over SARO, low and slow, the way the ones out on the land had moved.
